stops.name: Kleine Scheidegg
stops.quote: All through the year, the cog railway runs steeply up through a tunnel to the Jungfraujoch from Kleine Scheidegg.

stops.name: Eigergletscher
stops.quote: From the terminal in Grindelwald, a 3S cableway takes you directly to the station Eigergletscher (Eiger Glacier) in 15 minutes.

stops.name: Eiger North Face
stops.quote: One stop within the tunnel offers spectacular views onto the glacier world outside through windows in the Eiger North Face.

stops.name: Sphinx
stops.quote: All of this can be marvelled at from the viewing platforms “ Sphinx” and “Plateau” on the Aletsch glacier or from the “Ice Palace”.

stops.name: Aletsch glacier
stops.quote: Specials: Europe’s highest-altitude station at 3454 m a.s.l., Europe’s highest-altitude post office with its own area code (3801), Aletsch glacier – at 23 kilometres the longest Alpine glacier.

stops.name: Eiger Trail
stops.quote: The Eiger Trail goes within touching distance of the north face of the Eiger.
